g.text: Early fees account for 48% of GP receipt value
Fees begin at t = 0; carry first appears at the end of Year 8.
Fund GP receipts. Nominal amounts and PV at model inception are separate measures; each bar is 100% of its own total.
PV uses a 15% assumed discount rate. Before operating costs.
Not a GP profit share and not an estimate of TPG's own cost of capital.
